packageRules.description: Ignore local goopy module (replaced via go.mod replace directive)
Ignore our own CI-built deploy images — private GHCR packages consumed as :latest; Renovate can't auth to them (causes 'No docker auth found' warning) and must not digest-pin them
Catch-all: batch all remaining npm minor/patch into one rolling PR, automerged when CI is green. Specific ecosystem rules below override groupName and automerge. Majors stay individual.

Nuxt + Vite move together — nuxt releases track vite compatibility. nuxt-* covers the Nuxt SEO module family (nuxt-site-config, nuxt-og-image, nuxt-ai-ready, ...), whose peer ranges must move with @nuxtjs/seo or the install breaks. vue and vue-router are direct nuxt dependencies: bumping nuxt alone (e.g. 4.6.2 needs vue ^3.5.44) installs a second vue copy, and Nuxt auto-import types then miss the templates (#307).
Vue ecosystem (vue and vue-router move with nuxt, above)
Tailwind — @tailwindcss/vite is versioned in lockstep with tailwindcss
TypeScript + vue-tsc — vue-tsc tracks TS compiler compatibility

Keep typescript on 6.x. TypeScript 7 ships only the native compiler with no JS compiler API (no lib/tsc), so vue-tsc fails with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED (#218). The TS 7.0 announcement says Vue projects must wait for the API planned for 7.1. Remove once vue-tsc supports TypeScript 7.
oxc tooling — plugin API must stay compatible with the oxlint version (if oxlint-plugin-complexity breaks, pin oxlint to the last working version)
Test tooling (must come after vue/nuxt rules so @vue/test-utils and @nuxt/test-utils land here)
Go dependencies (both api and goopy modules)
Go toolchain moves atomically: go directive in go.mod files + golang base image (must come after the docker rule to pull golang out of the docker group)
